fusion.seeds_note: Deterministic: seeds 0, 1 and 2 give the identical result.

quantum_kernel_decision_rules.note: svm.predict uses one-vs-one votes; a 3-way vote tie is given to the first class. The fusion at alpha = 1 equals the argmax rule.

robustness_paired.protocol: Gaussian noise sigma x training std of each raw feature, added to validation; models trained on clean data; 5 draws per sigma; generator re-seeded (2026) for every model so all models see identical noisy copies.
